title: Putting it on the internet
subtitle: The live server is one service: a build command, a start command, a password
bullets: Build: install, pull the media, npm run build:live. Start: npm start
The password is set in the hosting service, never in git
Votes survive a redeploy only if the service has a persistent disk
An agent can prepare all of this and tell you what to set. Publishing is your decision, and your click
